name: weight_style
note: REVIEW: how much each part counts (rescaled to sum 1 over the parts that can be computed)

name: style_low
note: FashionCLIP similarity that counts as 0. Measured: real PolyVore outfits average 0.35 (5th percentile) to 0.55 (95th); the scale is kept wider so scores do not pile up at 0 or 100 (ties); see reports/compatibility_evaluation.md

name: max_bold_colours
note: more non-neutral colours than this costs colour points

name: bold_colour_penalty
note: colour points lost per extra non-neutral colour

name: min_pattern_conf
note: predicted patterns below this confidence are ignored

name: structure_no_shoes
note: structure score of a wearable outfit without shoes

name: structure_incomplete
note: structure score when the main pieces are missing (e.g. a top without a bottom)

name: structure_over_limit
note: structure score is multiplied by this for each item over its category limit

name: good_outfit
note: score (0-100) from which an outfit counts as good

name: buy_min_outfits
note: should I buy: at least this many good outfits where the new item beats what you own = buy

name: think_min_outfits
note: should I buy: at least this many = think about it; fewer = skip

name: same_colour
note: colour score of two items in the same bold colour (monochrome); same neutral = 1

name: similar_item
note: should I buy: FashionCLIP similarity from which a wardrobe item counts as a near twin

name: style_personal_weight
note: share of the style score based on the user's wardrobe taste

name: style_profile_min_items
note: minimum number of vectorized wardrobe items needed for personalization
